subject: The history view is good structurally
body_text:
Guten Tag,

The compose view needs the most polish first. Right now it looks too flat and spread out. It should become one compact central compose card with the send action integrated into the form instead of feeling detached.

The history view is good structurally, but the rows need stronger hierarchy. Sender, date, subject, and preview should read more like an email list and less like repeated cards.

The templates view is already closest to good. It mainly needs more balanced card height, lighter previews, and better badge styling.

The inbox view should get the biggest Gmail feel by improving row density, toolbar styling, search bar styling, and hover feedback.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Sprachschule Duisburg
